dedupe_keys.name: us crude oil pipeline accident greenhouse gas estimates

description: The US pipeline accident emissions research team publishes greenhouse-gas estimates associated with crude-oil gathering and transmission pipeline accidents. Its Figshare collection includes an accident-level spreadsheet for 7,656 events from 1968 to 2020, state summaries and annual summaries for the same period. Earlier gathering and transmission summary components also remain available. The principal XLSX deposits are free under CC0. These estimates can provide consequence benchmarks for pipeline-failure scenarios and complement the underlying incident perspective in data-phmsa-pipeline-incident-accident-data. A caveat is that the emissions are study estimates, not continuous measurements at each accident. The short component descriptions do not fully define every uncertainty column or calculation assumption, so users need the accompanying method before transferring values to new pipelines. This record covers accident emissions, not ordinary operational leakage. No spreadsheet was downloaded or emissions calculation repeated.
